links.context: This set of Database Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Relational Database and Database Schema”.

mcqs.question: A relational database consists of a collection of
mcqs.explanation: Fields are the column of the relation or tables. Records are each row in a relation. Keys are the constraints in a relation.

mcqs.question: A ________ in a table represents a relationship among a set of values.
mcqs.explanation: Column has only one set of values. Keys are constraints and row is one whole set of attributes. Entry is just a piece of data.

mcqs.question: The term _______ is used to refer to a row.
mcqs.explanation: Tuple is one entry of the relation with several attributes which are fields.

mcqs.question: The term attribute refers to a ___________ of a table.
mcqs.explanation: Attribute is a specific domain in the relation which has entries of all tuples.

mcqs.question: For each attribute of a relation, there is a set of permitted values, called the ________ of that attribute.
mcqs.explanation: The values of the attribute should be present in the domain. Domain is a set of values permitted.

mcqs.question: Database __________  which is the logical design of the database, and the database _______ which is a snapshot of the data in the database at a given instant in time.
mcqs.explanation: Instance is an instance of time and schema is a representation.

mcqs.question: Course(course_id,sec_id,semester) Here the course_id,sec_id and semester are __________ and course is a _________
mcqs.explanation: The relation course has a set of attributes course_id,sec_id,semester .

mcqs.question: Department (dept name, building, budget) and Employee (employee_id, name, dept name, salary) Here the dept_name attribute appears in both the relations. Here using common attributes in relation schema is one way of relating ___________ relations.
mcqs.explanation: Here the relations are connected by the common attributes.

mcqs.question: A domain is atomic if elements of the domain are considered to be ____________ units.
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: The tuples of the relations can be of ________ order.
mcqs.explanation: The values only count. The order of the tuples does not matter.

links.context: This set of Database Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Keys”.

mcqs.question: Which one of the following is a set of one or more attributes taken collectively to uniquely identify a record?
mcqs.explanation: Super key is the superset of all the keys in a relation.

mcqs.question: Consider attributes ID, CITY and NAME. Which one of this can be considered as a super key?
mcqs.explanation: Here the id is the only attribute which can be taken as a key. Other attributes are not uniquely identified.

mcqs.question: The subset of a super key is a candidate key under what condition?

options.a: a) No proper subset is a super key
options.b: b) All subsets are super keys
options.c: c) Subset is a super key
options.d: d) Each subset is a super key

mcqs.answer: a) No proper subset is a super key
mcqs.explanation: The subset of a set cannot be the same set. Candidate key is a set from a super key which cannot be the whole of the super set.

mcqs.question: A _____ is a property of the entire relation, rather than of the individual tuples in which each tuple is unique.
mcqs.explanation: Key is the constraint which specifies uniqueness.

mcqs.question: Which one of the following attribute can be taken as a primary key?
mcqs.explanation: The attributes name, street and department can repeat for some tuples. But the id attribute has to be unique. So it forms a primary key.

mcqs.question: Which one of the following cannot be taken as a primary key?
mcqs.explanation: Street is the only attribute which can occur more than once.

mcqs.question: An attribute in a relation is a foreign key if the _______ key from one relation is used as an attribute in that relation.
mcqs.explanation: The primary key has to be referred in the other relation to form a foreign key in that relation.

mcqs.question: The relation with the attribute which is the primary key is referenced in another relation. The relation which has the attribute as a primary key is called ______________
mcqs.explanation: The referenced relation is the table that contains the primary key being referenced.

mcqs.question: The ______ is the one in which the primary key of one relation is used as a normal attribute in another relation.
mcqs.explanation: The referencing relation is the table that contains the foreign key.

mcqs.question: A _________ integrity constraint requires that the values appearing in specified attributes of any tuple in the referencing relation also appear in specified attributes of at least one tuple in the referenced relation.
mcqs.explanation: A relation, say r1, may include among its attributes the primary key of another relation, say r2. This attribute is called a foreign key from r1, referencing r2. The relation r1 is also called the referencing relation of the foreign key dependency, and r2 is called the referenced relation of the foreign key.

links.context: This set of Database MCQs focuses on “Relational Query Operations and Relational Operators”.

mcqs.question: Using which language can a user request information from a database?
mcqs.explanation: Query language is a method through which the database entries can be accessed.

mcqs.question: Student(ID, name, dept name, tot_cred) In this query which attributes form the primary key?
mcqs.explanation: The attributes name, dept and tot_cred can have same values unlike ID.

mcqs.question: Which one of the following is a procedural language?
mcqs.explanation: Domain and Tuple relational calculus are non-procedural language. Query language is a method through which database entries can be accessed.

mcqs.question: The_____ operation allows the combining of two relations by merging pairs of tuples, one from each relation, into a single tuple.
mcqs.explanation: Join finds the common tuple in the relations and combines it.

mcqs.question: The result which operation contains all pairs of tuples from the two relations, regardless of whether their attribute values match.
mcqs.explanation: Cartesian product is the multiplication of all the values in the attributes.

mcqs.question: The _______operation performs a set union of two “similarly structured” tables
mcqs.explanation: Union just combines all the values of relations of same attributes.

mcqs.question: The most commonly used operation in relational algebra for projecting a set of tuple from a relation is
mcqs.explanation: Select is used to view the tuples of the relation with or without some constraints.

mcqs.question: The _______ operator takes the results of two queries and returns only rows that appear in both result sets.
mcqs.explanation: The union operator gives the result which is the union of two queries and difference is the one where query which is not a part of second query.

mcqs.question: A ________ is a pictorial depiction of the schema of a database that shows the relations in the database, their attributes, and primary keys and foreign keys.
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: The _________ provides a set of operations that take one or more relations as input and return a relation as an output.
mcqs.explanation: None.

links.text: SQL Basics and SQL Data Definition
links.context: This set of Database Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “SQL Basics and SQL Data Definition”.

mcqs.question: Which one of the following is used to define the structure of the relation, deleting relations and relating schemas?
mcqs.explanation: Data Definition language is the language which performs all the operation in defining structure of relation.

mcqs.question: Which one of the following provides the ability to query information from the database and to insert tuples into, delete tuples from, and modify tuples in the database?
mcqs.explanation: DML performs the change in the values of the relation.

mcqs.question:
CREATE TABLE employee (name VARCHAR, id INTEGER)
What type of statement is this?
mcqs.explanation: Data Definition language is the language which performs all the operation in defining structure of relation.

mcqs.question:
SELECT * FROM employee
What type of statement is this?
mcqs.explanation: Select operation just shows the required fields of the relation. So it forms a DML.

mcqs.question: The basic data type char(n) is a _____ length character string and varchar(n) is _____ length character.
mcqs.explanation: Varchar changes its length accordingly whereas char has a specific length which has to be filled by either letters or spaces.

mcqs.question: An attribute A of datatype varchar(20) has the value “Avi”. The attribute B of datatype char(20) has value  ”Reed”. Here attribute A has  ____ spaces and attribute B has ____ spaces.
mcqs.explanation: Varchar changes its length accordingly whereas char has a specific length which has to be filled by either letters or spaces.

mcqs.question: To remove a relation from an SQL database, we use the ______ command.
mcqs.explanation: Drop table deletes the whole structure of the relation .purge removes the table which cannot be obtained again.

mcqs.question:
DELETE FROM r;   //r - relation
This command performs which of the following action?
mcqs.explanation: Delete command removes the entries in the table.

mcqs.question:
INSERT INTO instructor VALUES (10211, ’Smith’, ’Biology’, 66000);
What type of statement is this?
mcqs.explanation: The values are manipulated. So it is a DML.

mcqs.question: Updates that violate __________ are disallowed.
mcqs.explanation: Integrity constraint has to be maintained in the entries of the relation.

links.context: This set of Database Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “SQL Queries”.

mcqs.question:
Name
Annie
Bob
Callie
Derek
Which of these query will display the the table given above ?
mcqs.explanation: The field to be displayed is included in select and the table is included in the from clause.

mcqs.question:
Here which of the following displays the unique values of the column? 
   SELECT ________ dept_name 
   FROM instructor;
mcqs.explanation: Distinct keyword selects only the entries that are unique.

mcqs.question: The ______ clause allows us to select only those rows in the result relation of the ____ clause that satisfy a specified predicate.
mcqs.explanation: Where selects the rows on a particular condition. From gives the relation which involves the operation.

mcqs.question:
The query given below will not give an error. Which one of the following has to be replaced to get the desired output? 
   SELECT ID, name, dept_name, salary * 1.1
   WHERE instructor;
mcqs.explanation: Where selects the rows on a particular condition. From gives the relation which involves the operation. Since Instructor is a relation it has to have from clause.

mcqs.question: The ________ clause is used to list the attributes desired in the result of a query.
mcqs.explanation: None

mcqs.question:
This Query can be replaced by which one of the following? 
   SELECT name, course_id
   FROM instructor, teaches
   WHERE instructor_ID= teaches_ID;

options.a: a) Select name,course_id from teaches,instructor where instructor_id=course_id;
options.b: b) Select name, course_id from instructor natural join teaches;
options.c: c) Select name, course_id from instructor;
options.d: d) Select course_id from instructor join teaches;

mcqs.answer: b) Select name, course_id from instructor natural join teaches;
mcqs.explanation: Join clause joins two tables by matching the common column.

mcqs.question:
SELECT * FROM employee WHERE salary>10000 AND dept_id=101;
Which of the following fields are displayed as output?

options.d: d) All the field of employee relation

mcqs.answer: d) All the field of employee relation
mcqs.explanation: Here * is used to select all the fields of the relation.

mcqs.question:
Employee_id Name Salary
1001 Annie 6000
1009 Ross 4500
1018 Zeith 7000

This is Employee table.
Which of the following employee_id will be displayed for the given query?

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements contains an error?

options.a: a) Select * from emp where empid = 10003;
options.b: b) Select empid from emp where empid = 10006;
options.d: d) Select empid where empid = 1009 and lastname = ‘GELLER’;

mcqs.answer: d) Select empid where empid = 1009 and lastname = ‘GELLER’;
mcqs.explanation: This query do not have from clause which specifies the relation from which the values has to be selected.

mcqs.question:
In the given query which of the keyword has to be inserted? 
INSERT INTO employee _____ (1002,Joey,2000);
mcqs.explanation: Value keyword has to be used to insert the values into the table.

mcqs.question:
SELECT name ____ instructor name, course id
FROM instructor, teaches
WHERE instructor.ID= teaches.ID;
Which keyword must be used here to rename the field name?
mcqs.explanation: As keyword is used to rename.

SELECT * FROM employee WHERE dept_name="Comp Sci";
In the SQL given above there is an error . Identify the error.
mcqs.explanation: For any string operations single quoted(‘) must be used to enclose.

mcqs.question:
SELECT emp_name
FROM department
WHERE dept_name LIKE ’ _____ Computer Science’;
Which one of the following has to be added into the blank to select the dept_name which has Computer Science as its ending string?
mcqs.explanation: The % character matches any substring.

mcqs.question: ’_ _ _ ’ matches any string of ______ three characters. ’_ _ _ %’ matches any string of at ______ three characters.
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question:
SELECT name
FROM instructor
WHERE dept name = ’Physics’
ORDER BY name;
By default, the order by clause lists items in ______ order.
mcqs.explanation: Specification of descending order is essential but it not for ascending.

mcqs.question:
SELECT *
FROM instructor
ORDER BY salary ____, name ___;
To display the salary from greater to smaller and name in ascending order which of the following options should be used?
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question:
SELECT name
FROM instructor
WHERE salary <= 100000 AND salary >= 90000;
This query can be replaced by which of the following ?

options.a:
a)
SELECT name
FROM instructor
WHERE salary BETWEEN 90000 AND 100000;
options.b:
b)
SELECT name
FROM employee
WHERE salary <= 90000 AND salary>=100000;
options.c:
c)
SELECT name
FROM employee
WHERE salary BETWEEN 90000 AND 100000;
options.d:
d)
SELECT name
FROM instructor
WHERE salary BETWEEN 100000 AND 90000;

mcqs.answer:
a)
SELECT name
FROM instructor
WHERE salary BETWEEN 90000 AND 100000;
mcqs.explanation: SQL includes a between comparison operator to simplify where clauses that specify that a value be less than or equal to some value and greater than or equal to some other value.

mcqs.question:
SELECT instructor.*
FROM instructor, teaches
WHERE instructor.ID= teaches.ID;
This query does which of the following operation?

options.a: a) All attributes of instructor and teaches are selected
options.b: b) All attributes of instructor are selected on the given condition
options.c: c) All attributes of teaches are selected on given condition
options.d: d) Only the some attributes from instructed and teaches are selected

mcqs.answer: b) All attributes of instructor are selected on the given condition
mcqs.explanation: The asterisk symbol “ * ” can be usedin the select clause to denote “all attributes.”

mcqs.question: In SQL the spaces at the end of the string are removed by _______ function.
mcqs.explanation: The syntax of trim is Trim(s); where s-string.

mcqs.question: _____ operator is used for appending two strings.
mcqs.explanation: || is the concatenation operator.

links.context: This set of Database Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Set Operations”.

mcqs.question: The union operation is represented by
mcqs.explanation: Union operator combines the relations.

mcqs.question: The intersection operator is used to get the _____ tuples.
mcqs.explanation: Intersection operator ignores unique tuples and takes only common ones.

mcqs.question: The union operation automatically __________ unlike the select clause.
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: If we want to retain all duplicates, we must write ________ in place of union.
mcqs.explanation: Union all will combine all the tuples including duplicates.

mcqs.question:
(SELECT course id
FROM SECTION
WHERE semester = ’Fall’ AND YEAR= 2009)
EXCEPT
(SELECT course id
FROM SECTION
WHERE semester = ’Spring’ AND YEAR= 2010);
This query displays

options.a: a) Only tuples from second part
options.b: b) Only tuples from the first part which has the tuples from second part
options.c: c) Tuples from both the parts
options.d: d) Tuples from first part which do not have second part

mcqs.answer: d) Tuples from first part which do not have second part
mcqs.explanation: Except keyword is used to ignore the values.

mcqs.question:
For like predicate which of the following is true. 
i) % matches zero OF more characters.
ii) _ matches exactly one CHARACTER.
mcqs.explanation: The % wildcard matches zero or more characters, while the _ wildcard matches exactly one character. Together, they offer flexibility and precision in pattern matching within the like predicate.

mcqs.question: The number of attributes in relation is called as its
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: _____ clause is an additional filter that is applied to the result.
mcqs.explanation: Having is used to provide additional aggregate filtration to the query.

mcqs.question: _________ joins are SQL server default
mcqs.explanation: It is optional to give the inner keyword with the join as it is default.

mcqs.question: The _____________ is essentially used to search for patterns in target string.
mcqs.explanation: Like predicate matches the string in the given pattern.

links.context: This set of Database Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Null Values Operations”.

mcqs.question: A _____ indicates an absent value that may exist but be unknown or that may not exist at all.
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: If the attribute phone number is included in the relation all the values need not be entered into the phone number column. This type of entry is given as
mcqs.explanation: Null is used to represent the absence of a value.

mcqs.question: The predicate in a where clause can involve Boolean operations such as and. The result of true and unknown is_______ false and unknown is _____ while unknown and unknown is _____
mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question:
SELECT name
FROM instructor
WHERE salary IS NOT NULL;
Selects

options.b: b) Tuples with no null values

mcqs.answer: b) Tuples with no null values
mcqs.explanation: Not null constraint removes the tpules of null values.

mcqs.question: In an employee table to include the attributes whose value always have some value which of the following constraint must be used?
mcqs.explanation: Not null constraint removes the tuples of null values.

mcqs.question: Using the ______ clause retains only one copy of such identical tuples.
mcqs.explanation: Unique is a constraint.

mcqs.question:
CREATE TABLE employee (id INTEGER,name VARCHAR(20),salary NOT NULL);
INSERT INTO employee VALUES (1005,Rach,0);
INSERT INTO employee VALUES (1007,Ross, );
INSERT INTO employee VALUES (1002,Joey,335);
Some of these insert statements will produce an error. Identify the statement.
mcqs.explanation: Not null constraint is specified which means sone value (can include 0 also) should be given.

mcqs.question: The primary key must be

options.c: c) Both Unique and Not null
options.d: d) Either Unique or Not null

mcqs.answer: c) Both Unique and Not null
mcqs.explanation: Primary key must satisfy unique and not null condition for sure.

mcqs.question:
You attempt to query the database with this command: 
 SELECT nvl (100 / quantity, NONE)
     FROM inventory;
Why does this statement cause an error when QUANTITY values are null?

options.a: a) The expression attempts to divide by a null value
options.b: b) The data types in the conversion function are incompatible
options.c: c) The character string none should be enclosed in single quotes (‘ ‘)
options.d: d) A null value used in an expression cannot be converted to an actual value

mcqs.answer: a) The expression attempts to divide by a null value
mcqs.explanation: The expression attempts to divide by a null value is erroneous in sql.

mcqs.question: The result of _____unknown is unknown.
mcqs.explanation: Since unknown does not hold any value the value cannot have a reverse value.

Which of the following should be used to find the mean of the salary ?

mcqs.explanation: Distinct keyword is used to select only unique items from the relation.

mcqs.question: All aggregate functions except _____ ignore null values in their input collection.
mcqs.explanation: * is used to select all values including null.

mcqs.question: A Boolean data type that can take values true, false, and________
mcqs.explanation: Unknown values do not take null value but it is not known.

mcqs.question: The ____ connective tests for set membership, where the set is a collection of values produced by a select clause. The ____ connective tests for the absence of set membership.

mcqs.question: We can test for the nonexistence of tuples in a subquery by using the _____ construct.
mcqs.explanation: Exists is used to check for the existence of tuples.

links.context: This set of Database Questions and Answers focuses on “Aggregate Functions and Nested Subqueries – 2”.

mcqs.question:
SELECT dept_name, ID, avg (salary)
FROM instructor
GROUP BY dept_name;
This statement IS erroneous because

options.a: a) Avg(salary) should not be selected
options.b: b) Dept_id should not be used in group by clause
options.d: d) Group by clause is not valid in this query

mcqs.answer: b) Dept_id should not be used in group by clause
mcqs.explanation: Any attribute that is not present in the group by clause must appear only inside an aggregate function if it appears in the select clause, otherwise the query is treated as erroneous.

mcqs.question: SQL applies predicates in the _______ clause after groups have been formed, so aggregate functions may be used.
mcqs.explanation: The Having clause in SQL is used to apply predicates after groups have been formed using the Group By clause. This allows aggregate functions to be used and filters the grouped data based on specified conditions.

mcqs.question: Aggregate functions can be used in the select list or the_______clause of a select statement or subquery. They cannot be used in a ______ clause.
mcqs.explanation: To include aggregate functions having clause must be included after where.

mcqs.question: The ________ keyword is used to access attributes of preceding tables or subqueries in the from clause.
mcqs.explanation:
Eg : SELECT name, salary, avg salary
            FROM instructor I1, lateral (SELECT avg(salary) AS avg salary
            FROM instructor I2
            WHERE I2.dept name= I1.dept name);

Without the lateral clause, the subquery cannot access the correlation variable
I1 from the outer query.

mcqs.question: Which of the following creates a temporary relation for the query on which it is defined?
mcqs.explanation: The with clause provides a way of defining a temporary relation whose definition is available only to the query in which the with clause occurs.

mcqs.question:
WITH max_budget (VALUE) AS
(SELECT MAX(budget)
FROM department)
SELECT budget
FROM department, max_budget
WHERE department.budget = MAX budget.value;
In the query given above which one of the following is a temporary relation?
mcqs.explanation: With clause creates a temporary relation.

mcqs.question: Subqueries cannot:

options.a: a) Use group by or group functions
options.b: b) Retrieve data from a table different from the one in the outer query
options.d: d) Appear in select, update, delete, insert statements.

mcqs.explanation: None.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not an aggregate function?
mcqs.explanation: With is used to create temporary relation and its not an aggregate function.

mcqs.question: The EXISTS keyword will be true if:

options.a: a) Any row in the subquery meets the condition only
options.b: b) All rows in the subquery fail the condition only
options.c: c) Both of these two conditions are met
options.d: d) Neither of these two conditions is met

mcqs.answer: a) Any row in the subquery meets the condition only
mcqs.explanation: EXISTS keyword checks for existance of a condition.

mcqs.question: How can you find rows that do not match some specified condition?

options.b: b) Double use of NOT EXISTS

mcqs.answer: b) Double use of NOT EXISTS
mcqs.explanation: None.

links.context: This set of Database Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Modification of Database”.

options.c: c) Delete from instructor where salary between 13000 and 15000;
